drafts.subject: Re: jac-cloud on Kubernetes
drafts.message:
Hi Amara,

Yes, jac-cloud fully supports deployment on your own Kubernetes cluster, including EKS. Additionally, it automatically handles horizontal scaling of walkers, so you won't need to manage replicas manually.

If you have any other questions, feel free to reach out!

Regards,
Impact Team
